'''Tony Reihl Endor drain''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Tony Reihl]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-14310">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14310 Endor drain], DeckTech (Tony "Pallaeon" Reihl, 6 March 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14310/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14310/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018035414/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14310/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Tony Reihl]]
* '''Published:''' 6 March 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Endor drain''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 ED Reihl DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits Vision: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' lots of power.

== Original post ==

'''Endor drain'''
* '''Author:''' Tony "Pallaeon" Reihl
* '''Published:''' March 6, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 0.5
* '''Description:''' lots of power.

=== Strategy ===

have lots of ability and power so your opponent

does not even have a fighting chance.
